findings.title: Attribution identifier rewrite lacks security sign-off
findings.problem: security-practices.md CRITICAL section forbids rewriting an identifier used for repository attribution without security-review sign-off; event cwd is now extractRepository(ctx.cwd), still schema_version 2, and no sign-off is recorded in the commit or range.
findings.impact: Guide classes such changes as CRITICAL because they can misattribute analytics; downstream consumers of absolute cwd were not verified from the diff.
findings.recommendation: Record the security-review sign-off and CRITICAL callout in the PR, or emit the identifier in a separate field leaving cwd unchanged (the latter departs from the approved design).
